record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 Temporal CoT repeatedly selects relevant video frames with a VLM and uses more inference-time compute to improve QA; a 32K-context run beats a 700K standard run by 2.8 points on long LVBench videos. It trades additional selection compute for context/quality in video QA, not a demonstrated serving-cost reduction.
record.title: Temporal Chain of Thought: Long-Video Understanding by Thinking in Frames
